Welcome—I'm so glad you're here.
Have you ever wondered what it really means to walk—and sometimes even run—side by side with a loving, powerful presence? Together, we’re about to step into a journey where faith isn’t just a quiet belief, but a living, ever-changing relationship with the divine.
In Liz Hill-O'Shea’s heartfelt guide, Running with God: A discipleship guide to grow in faith and experience the power and love of God, we’re invited to move beyond routines and checklists. Instead, we’ll discover how the longing for God’s love, and the desire to witness His power in our lives, shapes everything—inviting us to live with both surrender and boldness.
This isn’t about ticking off spiritual boxes. It’s about letting faith grow and stretch through real-life challenges, doubts, and those beautiful moments of grace that catch us off guard. Along the way, we’ll gather practical wisdom, encouragement, and a few stories that just might sound a lot like our own.
We’ll lean into prayer, scripture, and community—those steady rhythms that help us hold on to hope, even when the path gets tough. And as we move forward, you’ll discover simple but powerful steps you can take to deepen your relationship with God—steps that are meant to be lived, not just learned.
So, what if you could experience God’s love and power in a way that transforms your every day? That’s the invitation.
Let’s step forward together, with courage and curiosity, and see what it truly means to run with God.
